verdict.rationale: Mesh docs say you can set an initial risk score based on your own risk models and configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores. That gives business-specific scoring, but nothing shows the model accepts custom input signals such as device or behavioral data. Missing for 10: documented ingestion of device fingerprints, behavioral data, or arbitrary custom metadata as scoring inputs; detail on which risk factors the equation can use; independent or hands-on corroboration.
